messages:
Kai: quick note from a new user run — their node quickstart started showing DEBUG spam after OTEL_AUTO_INIT=true and retries generated new request ids.
Romi: can you share the log lines?
Kai: snippet: ```
INFO  auth: got token
DEBUG http: req=rid-7 -> POST /v1/chat
WARN  http: 401
DEBUG http: req=rid-13 -> retry POST /v1/chat
```
Kai: also the payload included inline code like `secret: `foo123`` and it showed up unredacted in the DEBUG message.
Anu: two problems: retry layer not preserving request id, and redaction runs after otel-autoinit flips log level so early messages escape.
Romi: plan: (1) change retry to reuse ctx.requestId if present and copy X-Request-Id into retry headers, (2) add a logging.Filter that redacts message text at emit time as a last-resort, (3) make OTEL_AUTO_INIT opt-in for debug-exporter toggles.
Kai: i've put a minimal repro in internal sampleapp link (private) and filed DX-1510.
ci-bot: created branch telemetry/reqid-redact-filter and queued CI.
devx-bot: ticket DX-1510 "preserve request id on retry + logging redaction filter for OTEL auto-init" created and linked PR #701.
Romi: i'll open the PR today with unit tests for header propagation and a small e2e that simulates 401+retry and a backticked secret block.
Anu: add a short onboarding note too: set OTEL_AUTO_INIT=0 if you see unexpected DEBUG logs during setup.
Kai: thanks — will update the onboarding doc after PR lands.
